title: One shotted in 2 hours with just Opus 5.5 on phone
author: Hour_Disk_1209
selftext:
Literally one shotted a mobile game i had in mind since long. 

Took my phone this morning, asked Claude (opus 5.5 medium) with precise indications about the game and just deliver me complete apk, built in godot 4.7. Grabbed some free models on sketchfab and images of the focus cockpits ( my favourite car) and that's it. Of course there are bugs and things to arrange but I think we reached the quality we were paying for. 

One finger gameplay, hold for gas, swipe up or down to increse/decrease gas, swipe left or right to force line change, double tap for nitro and release to auto break, back in the line and cruise driving (auto drive following rules). There is a career mode and an endless mode, day and night cycles, gas indicator and engine heat indicator... Realistic car behaviors and sounds, upgrades etc.

Also added damages on all model, and again, being a one shot build is super fine. He couldn't manage car lighting and exhauste well tough.

Anyway, happy to proceed with the prompts this weeks to see where this can go. 

P.S I'm an old time game dev developing games in unity and godot way before AI agents
